channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: No primeiro mês de Desenrola, endividamento e inadimplência continuaram iguais
item.description: In the first month of the Desenrola Brasil program, launched in May, household debt and delinquency indicators remained largely unchanged, staying at record levels. The share of income committed to debt payments (excluding real estate financing) was 31.1% in May, down slightly from 31.2% in April, while delinquency rose from 7.4% to 7.6%, reaching its highest level since 2012.

item.title: Negociação de imóvel para Wagner seguiu após prisão de Vorcaro, diz PF
item.description: The Federal Police states that negotiations for the purchase of a luxury apartment for Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) continued after the arrest of Banco Master’s former owner, Daniel Vorcaro, in November 2025, through 'contractual maneuvers' to conceal the illicit deal. The senator says he is calm and focused on the October elections, asserting he will prove his innocence and highlighting his support for Lula. Investigations are examining whether Wagner received improper benefits in exchange for legislative actions favoring Banco Master, within the Compliance Zero operation.

item.title: 'Pai do Lulinha’ e ‘onde está filho do presidente?': campanha de Flávio prepara ofensiva após nova investigação da PF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign plans to use the new investigation into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, to attack President Lula in the 2026 election by calling him 'the father of Lulinha' and asking 'where is the son'. The strategy includes raising the issue in speeches at PL conventions in Santa Catarina, Tarcísio de Freitas' event in São Paulo, and in Paraíba and the Federal District, focusing on social media and public agendas to consistently wear down the opponent.

item.title: Paraguai entrega nota de repúdio a embaixador brasileiro
item.description: Paraguay delivered a diplomatic note of protest to Brazil's ambassador after President Lula claimed Paraguay 'invaded' Brazil during the Paraguayan War (1864-1870). Paraguay views the statement as an affront to its national memory, while Brazil signaled it will not respond, aiming to avoid historical debate and maintain bilateral relations.

item.title: Líder nas pesquisas ao Senado em SP, Marina Silva prega união com Simone Tebet e mira gestão Tarcísio
item.description: Marina Silva leads Senate race polls in São Paulo with 31% in Paraná Pesquisas and advocates for a ticket with Simone Tebet to boost women's political representation. She criticizes São Paulo's sluggish economic growth under Tarcísio de Freitas (1% in 2025 vs. 2.3% nationally) and highlights a 10% rise in femicide in the state during the first half of 2026, calling for urgent public safety measures.

item.title: Lula lidera no 1º e no 2º turno, mostra pesquisa, que traz disputa mais apertada contra Caiado
item.description: Lula leads voting intentions in the first round and would defeat all tested opponents in a potential second round, according to the Alfa Intelligence poll released this Friday. The tightest race is against Goiás Governor Ronaldo Caiado, who emerges as his main challenger. The survey was commissioned by TMC and published on March 31.

item.title: Lula diz que não tem a ‘quantidade de craques que queria’ ao citar sucessor
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva admitted difficulty in naming a successor for 2026, stating no current candidate can defeat the far-right, which led him to pursue a fourth term. He cited Dilma Rousseff (2010) and Fernando Haddad (2018) as examples of PT-developed successors and suggested new names may emerge from the 2026 state elections. Lula said he would have preferred to rest but feels compelled to run to block the far-right’s return, emphasizing his strong physical condition at 80 to counter age-related criticisms.

item.title: La policía de Brasil investigará a un hijo de Lula por presunta corrupción y tráfico de influencias
item.description: Brazil's Federal Police will launch an investigation into Fábio Luís da Silva, known as Lulinha, one of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's five sons, on suspicions of corruption and influence peddling. The probe was authorized by the Supreme Federal Court following evidence that he may have leveraged his family name to facilitate business deals for friends in Brasília.

item.title: Cúpula do PP avalia que Tereza Cristina aceitou convite de Flávio porque sabia que partido barraria chapa
item.description: The leadership of the Progressistas (PP) believes that Senator Tereza Cristina accepted the invitation to be Flávio Bolsonaro’s running mate solely to appease agribusiness pressures in Mato Grosso do Sul, knowing the party would oppose the ticket. The PP argues that the PL 'missed the timing' for the alliance by failing to convene a national convention within the legal deadline, and that supporting the Bolsonaro candidate is no longer advantageous in the current political landscape, which favors Lula.

item.title: Lula reúne equipe econômica antes de viagem para convenções do PT
item.description: President Lula met with his economic team on July 31, 2026, at the Palácio da Alvorada to discuss fiscal and spending agenda ahead of PT conventions in Ceará and Bahia. Attendees included Finance Minister Dario Durigan, Planning Minister Bruno Moretti, Management and Innovation Minister Esther Dweck, and Secom Secretary Sidônio Palmeira. Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira was present but left before the meeting began for another engagement with the president.

item.title: Flávio e a jornada de um candidato sem alianças
item.description: The PP declared neutrality and blocked Tereza Cristina from being Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate, despite Bolsonaro claiming she had accepted the offer. Bolsonaro stated he continues talks with other parties, such as Republicans, to form his ticket. Lulinha's defense is studying a request to move a new investigation against him to a lower court, while Eduardo Bolsonaro cried when mentioning prison and threatened Kim with 'desire to beat him up' in the U.S.

item.title: Governo destina R$ 3,4 bi para subsídio de combustíveis
item.description: The federal government allocated R$ 3.473 billion in extraordinary credit to subsidize fuels, with R$ 2.230 billion for road diesel and R$ 1.243 billion for other petroleum derivatives. The measure was published in the Official Gazette on July 31, 2026, via MP nº 1.381, and signed by President Lula and Minister Bruno Moretti. Resources are managed by the Ministry of Mines and Energy, based on prior 2026 MPs.

item.title: Força eleitoral de Lula ainda é insuficiente para criar ‘onda vermelha’ nos estados
item.description: Lula leads presidential polls in eight of Brazil’s nine largest electoral colleges, confirming his favoritism for re-election in 2026. However, governors backed by him are leading in only one state (RJ, with Eduardo Paes) and trailing or tied in SP, PR, MG, and CE, revealing a split between presidential and gubernatorial voting. The PT aims to strengthen the link between regional candidates and Lula to create a 'red wave' and transfer presidential strength to state races.

item.title: Depois de polêmica em 2022, ACM Neto se declara branco à Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: ACM Neto, former mayor of Salvador and União Brasil candidate for governor of Bahia in 2026, declared himself white in electoral court records, reversing his 2022 self-identification as pardo, which had sparked controversy. He also doubled his declared assets from R$41.7 million to R$48.8 million. Despite the backlash, a Quaest poll shows him technically tied with incumbent governor Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT), with 39% versus 38% voting intentions.

item.title: Como vai funcionar o ‘Pix Pensão’, que torna o pagamento do pai automático
item.description: Law 15.479/26, signed by President Lula, establishes the 'Pix Child Support' system, enabling automatic and recurring payments via Pix to combat delinquency and reduce judicial overload. The law is in effect now, but its rules will apply starting July 2027, after a one-year adaptation period. While automatic deductions from formal salaries already existed, the new rule extends the mechanism to informal and self-employed workers, facilitating compliance with child support obligations.

item.title: Saiba quando começa a propaganda eleitoral e conheça as novas regras para as Eleições 2026
item.description: Electoral propaganda for the 2026 General Elections begins on August 16, as per TSE resolution, which strengthens measures against disinformation and regulates the use of artificial intelligence. The campaign includes online activities, free electoral airtime on radio and TV, and requires electronic addresses to be reported to the Electoral Justice, with updates within 24 hours if created during the campaign period.

item.title: Bastidores: PF tentou evitar distribuição automática para André Mendonça de nova investigação sobre Lulinha
item.description: The Federal Police attempted to prevent the automatic distribution of an investigation into Fábio Luis Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, to Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, sparking a behind-the-scenes conflict between the PF, the PGR, and the Court’s presidency. Tensions between investigators and Mendonça’s office escalated over nearly a week, culminating in an electronic reversal in the case assignment process.

item.title: União Brasil adia decisão sobre candidatura de ex-deputado investigado pela PF para o Senado no RJ
item.description: União Brasil postponed its decision on the Senate candidacy of Márcio Canella, former Rio de Janeiro state deputy under investigation by the Federal Police for suspected money laundering involving gas stations, for the 2026 election. Canella is part of the alliance supporting Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ)'s presidential bid.

item.title: O humor de Lula na reunião com os comandantes militares
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva displayed good humor during a meeting with military commanders at the Palácio do Planalto on Thursday (30). The conversation focused on promotions within the Armed Forces. The meeting was described as relaxed, drawing attention from attendees.

item.title: Em evento com Nunes e Tarcísio, Flávio diz que Lula se vinga de SP
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused President Lula of seeking revenge against São Paulo due to the positions of Mayor Ricardo Nunes and Governor Tarcísio de Freitas. He claimed that a new Lula nomination to the Supreme Federal Court would create legal insecurity and hinder major projects and investments in the state. The remarks were made during a breakfast event with Nunes and Tarcísio, attended by city councilors and supporters.

item.title: Caiado usa inquérito contra Lulinha para criticar Lula e Bolsonaro: 'rei protege o príncipe'
item.description: Goiás governor and presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) following the opening of an investigation into Lula's son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva ('Lulinha'), who is suspected of influence peddling in the federal government. Caiado used the phrase 'the king protects the prince' to allege governmental favoritism toward Lula's son, indirectly referencing Jair Bolsonaro in his critique, though Bolsonaro is not explicitly named as the target of the remark.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula não quer renovação alguma na política
item.description: Lula stated he does not seek political renewal and has already prepared many names for succession, citing Brazil’s first female president and Fernando Haddad as examples. He emphasized his strategy is to build leadership within the PT, not name a single successor for 2026. The remarks were made during an interview on the Inteligência Ltda podcast.

item.title: Jaques Wagner diz ter certeza de que vai provar sua inocência na investigação do caso Master
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) said he is confident he will prove his innocence in the Master case investigation, which involves suspicions of bribery from Banco Master, and emphasized his focus on the October elections, with a convention scheduled for August 1 featuring Lula. He compared the current situation to the 2018, being investigated for the Fonte Nova Arena case and the process was archived without indictment. Wagner also cited STF Minister André Mendonça, who authorized phone monitoring over suspected data leaks in Operation Compliance Zero, which investigates corruption and money laundering linked to Banco Master and Wagner’s alleged ties to its managers.

item.title: Flávio e PP: a neutralidade fala mais alto que um palanque
item.description: The Progressistas (PP) decided to remain neutral in the 2026 presidential race, which likely prevents Senator Tereza Cristina from joining Flávio Bolsonaro’s ticket. This decision reflects the Centrão’s customary practice of preserving post-election maneuverability, favoring party flexibility over immediate alliances. The PP announced its neutrality on Friday, the 31st, reinforcing its strategy of avoiding premature commitments in presidential contests.

item.title: Jaques Wagner diz que vai provar “inocência” e cita apoio de Lula
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) says he is certain he will prove his innocence in the Banco Master investigations, citing Lula’s support and his focus on the October elections. He said he met with the president a few days after the search and seizure operation and confirmed Lula will attend the PT’s convention in Bahia. A PF report, made public by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, alleges Wagner received economic benefits from former Banco Master partners and acted in Congress to benefit the bank.

item.title: PT oficializa Contarato como candidato à reeleição ao Senado no ES
item.description: The Workers' Party officially nominated Senator Fabiano Contarato as its candidate for re-election to the Senate from Espírito Santo, announced at a party convention held at Clube Álvares Cabral in Vitória. Evani Reis was confirmed as the first alternate and Neio Lúcio Pereira (PCdoB) as the second alternate. The candidacy was endorsed by the Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PV, and PCdoB), which also confirmed Helder Salomão as the gubernatorial candidate, with Professor Valdirene as his running mate.

item.title: Governistas e oposição reagem a investigação da PF contra Lulinha
item.description: The Federal Police was authorized to investigate Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), son of President Lula, on suspicion of influence peddling and corruption involving lobbyist 'Careca do INSS' to facilitate the commercialization of medicinal cannabidiol in government programs. While PT allies remained discreet, stating Lulinha will be treated like any citizen, opposition figures including Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) and Romeu Zema (Novo) drew parallels to Flávio Bolsonaro’s case, accusing the PT of nepotism and demanding accountability.

item.title: Jaques Wagner quebra silêncio, após novas revelações de envolvimento dele no caso Master
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) broke his silence after the lifting of secrecy in the decision authorizing the 9th phase of Operation Compliance Zero against him, stating he is calm and focused on the October elections. He compared the current situation to a similar episode in 2018, when he was accused in the Fonte Nova case and later not indicted, with the process archived. Wagner reiterated his innocence, trusted the work of the Federal Police, Public Prosecutor’s Office, and Judiciary, and quoted Lula to say only he knows what he did.

item.title: Eleições: regras buscam evitar uso da máquina pública por candidatos
item.description: Electoral legislation establishes strict rules for public agents — defined as anyone holding a mandate, position, employment, or function in public administration, even temporarily or without pay — to prevent the use of state resources in favor of candidates. Prohibitions include allocating public goods, using state-funded materials or services beyond legal limits, deploying public employees for campaign work during regular hours, and granting salary adjustments above inflation, with most rules taking effect 90 days before elections (July 4, 2026, for the 2026 elections). Violations may constitute abuse of political power, monitored by the Electoral Public Prosecutor’s Office and the TSE, to ensure equality among candidates.

item.title: Acordos nos estados e entrave no estatuto: por que PP barrou Tereza Cristina como vice de Flávio
item.description: The PP decided to remain neutral in the 2026 presidential election, rejecting the inclusion of Tereza Cristina as Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate due to concerns about jeopardizing existing state-level electoral agreements, particularly in the Northeast, and a statutory obstacle preventing last-minute position changes. The decision followed consultations with state directories and was formally communicated, with Senator Tereza Cristina accepting the party's stance. Internal assessments concluded that risking internal discord was not worthwhile for a candidacy with slim winning prospects, as shown by DataFolha polling indicating Flávio at 43% versus Lula's 48% in a potential runoff.

item.title: Crusoé: Cafezinho com Moraes foi para falar de Lulinha?
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes met with President Lula at the Palácio do Planalto after an official event on women's protection on Wednesday afternoon, the 29th. The informal meeting, described as a 'coffee chat', sparked speculation about whether the case of Lulinha, the president's son, was discussed. The encounter was captured on cameras and first reported by O Antagonista.

item.title: Após STF retirar sigilo de decisão sobre operação, Jaques Wagner diz que vai 'provar inocência'
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) stated he will prove his innocence in the investigations related to Operation Compliance Zero, after Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça lifted the secrecy of the decision authorizing the monitoring of his cellphone. Wagner said he is calm and focused on the October elections, where he will seek re-election to the Senate, noting he was investigated in 2018 without conviction. He emphasized that the Federal Police and Federal Prosecutor's Office have freedom to act, and the monitoring was authorized due to alleged leak risks and the use of voice calls to avoid written records in dealings with Banco Master.

item.title: Entenda a investigação da PF sobre Lulinha e tráfico de influência
item.description: The Federal Police is investigating Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), son of President Lula, on suspicion of influence peddling related to the cannabidiol market and the company World Cannabis, linked to lobbyist known as 'Careca do INSS'. The investigation, authorized by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, examines whether Lulinha and Roberta Luchsinger exerted undue influence at the Ministry of Health and the Presidency to favor the legalization and commercialization of medicinal cannabis in government programs.

item.title: Agarrado a Lula, João Campos tenta colar Raquel Lyra em Flávio
item.description: Former Recife mayor João Campos (PSB) attempted to link Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) to Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) by claiming she, like other Pernambuco right-wing figures, would receive his support. The statement was made to reinforce Campos’ alignment with Lula and the PT, positioning himself as opposition to the local right.

item.title: Nova lei destina parte da arrecadação com bets para a Polícia Federal
item.description: President Lula signed Law 15.480/26, allocating a portion of revenue from fixed-odds betting (bets) to the Funapol fund of the Federal Police, with progressive percentages: 1% in 2026, 2% in 2027, and 3% from 2028 onward. The law also authorizes an increase in Funapol’s allocations by up to R$200 million in 2026 using freely available National Treasury resources, and expands the fund’s use to cover health expenses for PF, PRF, and PPF servants, as well as potential funding for extraordinary activity bonuses, subject to a specific law.

item.title: Caiado usa inquérito contra Lulinha para criticar Lula e Bolsonaro: ‘Rei protege o príncipe’
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) following the opening of an inquiry into his son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), suspected of influence peddling in the federal government. Caiado accused Lula of 'pretending not to see' his son's alleged misconduct and likened the situation to a 'monarchy disguised as a republic,' extending the critique to the Bolsonaro family without naming them directly.

item.title: Flávio chama medida da PF contra Mendonça de “palhaçada”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the Federal Police for requesting the Attorney General's Office to challenge Minister André Mendonça of the Supreme Federal Court, calling the measure as ' . He referenced past investigations against Jair sonaro and called the move a 'farce'. He claimed the PF is acting with bias, recalling past investigations against Jair Bolsonaro, and denied any impartiality in the case involving Lulinha, President Lula's son.

item.title: Caiado critica Lula após abertura de investigação contra Lulinha: 'Rei protege o príncipe'
item.description: PSD presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado criticized President Lula after the STF authorized a new investigation into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), accusing the government of operating as a 'monarchy disguised as a republic' where the 'king protects the prince'. Caiado implied a pattern of familial protection in politics, without naming others directly, but suggesting the critique could apply to other cases involving presidential sons under investigation.

item.title: PT diz que Milei “não pode confundir suas atribuições”
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva criticized Argentine President Javier Milei for attacking President Lula and confusing his role as head of state with political militancy, calling it the worst diplomatic crisis between Brazil and Argentina in decades. Edinho said the PT filed a complaint to investigate whether Milei’s trip to Brazil was funded by Argentine public resources, which could constitute foreign interference in Brazil’s electoral process, and urged the Public Prosecutor’s Office and Electoral Justice to investigate.

item.title: Tereza de vice pressionaria PP e União a financiar maior rival pela Câmara
item.description: The potential nomination of Tereza Cristina as Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate faces resistance from PP and União Brasil, as it would require reallocating electoral fund resources meant for congressional candidates to finance the PL presidential ticket, weakening the Progressista Union's goal of expanding its congressional blocs. Leaders fear that funding the PL ticket would indirectly benefit their main rival in the race for the largest Chamber caucus, by freeing up PL resources for its own congressional candidates. The federation's neutrality is seen as strategically preserving funds and avoiding internal conflict over resource allocation.

item.title: Sem Lula na TV, Flávio foge para não virar alvo da direita
item.description: Lula's absence from TV debates opened a window for Flávio Bolsonaro to avoid confrontation, fearing he would become a target for the traditional right, which views him as weak and vulnerable without Lula as a counterpoint. Meanwhile, the STF is reviewing the illegal use of AI at the PL convention, with Alexandre de Moraes set to rule on the Bolsonaro clan's attempt to bypass judicial restrictions — a situation legally distinct from Lula's 2018 case.

item.title: Análise: Investigações sobre Jaques Wagner e sobre Lulinha criam novo desafio ao Planalto
item.description: Decisions by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça lifted secrecy on documents related to the investigation of Senator Jaques Wagner and authorized an inquiry into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), the president’s eldest son, on suspicion of corruption and influence peddling. These moves revived the politically charged Banco Master case, creating new challenges for Lula’s re-election campaign, though government allies argue the investigations demonstrate the Federal Police’s independence by targeting figures from both the government and opposition.

item.title: Dívida pública sobe 10 pontos do PIB na parcial do governo Lula e atinge 81,9%, maior nível em mais de 5 anos
item.description: Brazil's public debt rose to 81.9% of GDP in June, up 1 percentage point from May and accumulating 10.2 points since the end of 2022 under the Lula administration. It is the highest level since April 2021, nearing the pandemic peak of 87.7%, and according to the IMF, reaches 95.8% of GDP when including central bank debt. The increase pressures interest rates and constrains growth, as former Central Bank president Roberto Campos Neto noted.

item.title: PF abre inquérito contra Lulinha: entenda o que está sendo investigado
item.description: The Federal Police opened an investigation to determine if Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), son of President Lula, committed influence peddling and corruption by allegedly facilitating meetings between lobbyist Antônio Carlos Camilo Antunes ('Careca do INSS') and Health Ministry officials regarding medicinal cannabis contracts. The probe, authorized by Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça, does not concern the pension frauds of Operation Sem Desconto but focuses on Lulinha’s alleged use of influence to benefit Antunes in negotiations for cannabidiol-based drugs. Antunes has been imprisoned since September 2024 for his role in the INSS fraud scheme.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro chora, cita temor de ser preso e critica Kim por declaração contra Flávio: 'Vontade de pegar de porrada'
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro cried during a speech in Florida, expressing fear of arrest and alleging political persecution against his family, comparing Brazil’s situation to historical authoritarian regimes. He criticized the investigation into an AI-generated video involving his father Jair Bolsonaro, cited high legal costs and precautions against Interpol, and challenged right-wing allies to run for office instead of attacking his brother Flávio Bolsonaro, while referencing rumors about compromising videos of the latter.

item.title: Resistência no PP trava vice de Tereza Cristina
item.description: The PL's effort to include Senator Tereza Cristina (MS) as vice-presidential candidate on a ticket led by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro is facing resistance within the Progressistas (PP). Most state-level PP leaders have opposed her nomination, communicating their stance to the party's national president. This is blocking the advancement of the PL-PP alliance for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Raquel Lyra e João Campos têm empate técnico pelo governo de PE
item.description: A Real Time Big Data survey conducted between July 27 and 30, 2026 shows a technical tie between Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) and former Recife mayor João Campos (PSB) in the Pernambuco gubernatorial race, with 45% and 44% voter intention, respectively. The 1-point difference falls within the 2-point margin of error at a 95% confidence level. The poll surveyed 1,600 voters and is registered with the TSE under number PE-08413/2026.

item.title: O trabalho ‘patriótico’ do agora ex-publicitário de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Former advertiser Eduardo Fischer, previously announced as strategic communications consultant for Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign, was dropped by the PL after claiming in court he had no contracts or receivables from the party or candidate, despite court-ordered asset freezes to pay old debts. The PL praised his 'patriotic work,' implying services were rendered without payment to avoid using campaign funds for personal debts. Fischer and his partner were replaced by Duda Lima, and neither the campaign nor the party responded to requests for clarification on their relationship.

item.title: Nova pesquisa reforça tendência de alta de Lula e sinaliza dificuldades de Flávio
item.description: A new survey by Alfa Inteligência shows Lula leading with 43% voting intention in the first round, up three points from June, while Flávio Bolsonaro drops to 29%, reflecting difficulties after changing his campaign manager and controversies linked to the Banco Master scandal. In potential runoffs, Lula would defeat all tested opponents, leading Flávio by 7 points (48% to 41%) and maintaining similar leads against Caiado, Zema, and Renan Santos. 'Third way' candidates remain stagnant at low levels.

item.title: O favoritismo de Lula contra todos os rivais em 1º e 2º turno, segundo nova pesquisa
item.description: Lula leads the 2026 presidential race with 48% in the second round against Flávio Bolsonaro (41%), within the margin of error, and wins all second-round scenarios against Ronaldo Caiado (45% to 40%), Renan Santos (46% to 32%), and Romeu Zema (46% to 37%). In the first round, Lula has 43% versus Bolsonaro's 29%, gaining 3 points since June while Bolsonaro lost 2.
